val.jpgPng: Use a JPG or PNG photo.
val.pdfJpgPng: Use a PDF, JPG or PNG file.
val.tooBig: This file is bigger than 2 MB. Choose a smaller one.
val.phone: Enter a valid Malaysian number, e.g. +60 12-345 6789.
val.shopLong: Keep the shop name under 80 characters.
val.ssm: Enter your SSM number, e.g. 202301012345 or 1234567-A.
val.address: Enter your address or stall number.
val.pin: Set the map pin so customers can find you.
val.cuisine: Enter at least one cuisine type.
val.cuisineLong: Keep it under 40 characters, e.g. Noodles, Drinks.
val.halal: Tell customers whether your food is halal.
val.oneDay: Open on at least one day.
val.closeAfter: Closing time must be after opening time.
val.service: Turn on at least one way to get food.
val.minOrder: Enter an amount like 5.00, or leave it empty.
val.allergens: Tick the allergens used in your kitchen, or tick "None of these".
val.licence: Enter your food hygiene or business licence number.
val.terms: Tick the box to agree to the merchant terms.
val.latNumber: Latitude must be a number such as 1.5533.
val.lngNumber: Longitude must be a number such as 110.3592.
val.latRange: Latitude must be between -90 and 90 (Kuching is about 1.55).
val.lngRange: Longitude must be between -180 and 180 (Kuching is about 110.36). Check for a missing decimal point.
